# STATUS

> Every page of the STATUS module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Status and search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-100/docs/nhcx/v1/api/status): The Status and search calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Payer: send the search result](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-100/docs/nhcx/v1/api/status/endpoints/status-v1-search-on-submit): Callback returning a search result for task type code=poll; for a claim-document search the payload is the ClaimResponse for the reference number.
- [Authorised entity: search for claim information](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-100/docs/nhcx/v1/api/status/endpoints/status-v1-search-submit): Authorised entity such as NHA or IRDAI sends a Task to retrieve claim information for a case; the payer returns the documents on the search callback.
- [Sender: check the status of a request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-100/docs/nhcx/v1/api/status/endpoints/status-v1-status): Sender asks NHCX where its own in-flight request stands; the gateway answers request.queued or request.dispatched, and only dispatched yields a callback.
- [Authorised entity receives the search result](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-100/docs/nhcx/v1/api/status/endpoints/status-webhook-v1-search-on-submit): Hosted by the participant that sent the search, such as NHA or a regulator. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at...
- [Payer receives a claim search](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-100/docs/nhcx/v1/api/status/endpoints/status-webhook-v1-search-submit): Hosted by the payer. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/search/submit, with the headers and the sealed payload the...
- [Payer receives a status check](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-100/docs/nhcx/v1/api/status/endpoints/status-webhook-v1-status): Hosted by the payer. The exchange posts this message to the endpoint_url you registered, at /v1/status, with the headers and the sealed payload the sender...
- [Status and search errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-100/docs/nhcx/v1/api/status/errors): What Status and search returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
